findings: Fail-closed boundaries hold: grounding failures, malformed reviews, wrong-family or CI-tainted receipts, missing outputs, and the two-round revision limit all write a persistent blocked.json (BaseException handlers) and re-raise; nothing partial is presented as approved.

Identity bindings hold: predecessor interpretation receipts are re-hashed in campaign_pipeline.grounding (import receipt, interpretation, review, next-decision proposal, prior SPEC); imports are inventory-checked at grounding, record-result (before and after copy), and interpret-build.

Authority preserved: all statuses are explicitly agent-scoped (PROPOSAL_ONLY, REVIEWED_PROPOSAL_NOT_ADOPTED, AGENT_REVIEWED_NOT_HUMAN_RATIFIED, VALIDATED_EXPLORATORY_IMPORT); the pipeline never writes into experiments/; commit() refuses out-of-scope paths before staging; no human markers are synthesized.

Advisory: campaign_lifecycle.context() checks predecessor import/interpretation/review/SPEC hashes but omits the proposal_sha256 (investigator_next_decision.json) binding and the per-file symlink checks that campaign_pipeline.grounding() enforces; mirror grounding's checks for consistency.

Advisory (correctness, fails closed): commit()'s strict scope check will reject untracked byproducts such as exp/__pycache__ from py_compile in probe-build (and test byproducts in verify-probe) unless the repo gitignores them, which can make those commands unusable rather than unsafe.

Advisory (evidence integrity): prompt_*.md, log_*.txt, and appended stage_provenance.jsonl are copied from the disposable root the agent could write to, so persisted evidence and efficiency_review metrics are agent-influenced; the authority gate itself uses run_agent's final receipt line and receipt input/artifact hashes, so approvals are unaffected.

Future-scoped (privacy): colab-worker-future.json hook-guards only get_cells; run_code_cell results are ungated if the MCP server returns outputs. REVIEW_RESOLUTION_20260905 acknowledges this as adapter-constrained and not installed; it must remain a blocking item for any activation review, and the /usr/sbin/python absolute hook path needs revalidation per host (the builder does fail closed on both).

Minor: mkdtemp roots (profile dir in system_stage, disposable stage repos) are never cleaned up, leaving bound context in /tmp (mode 0700); grounding includes SPEC.md/run.py only when present, so a code/repair proposal can be authored with no specification in context (proposal-only, no authority impact); request.json hardcodes family 'codex' though the transaction involves both families.
